# VT100 Test Sequences

# Basic cursor movement
ESC[A - Cursor up
ESC[B - Cursor down
ESC[C - Cursor forward
ESC[D - Cursor back
ESC[10A - Cursor up 10 lines
ESC[5;10H - Cursor to row 5, column 10

# Screen manipulation
ESC[2J - Clear entire screen
ESC[J - Clear from cursor to end of screen
ESC[1J - Clear from cursor to beginning of screen
ESC[K - Clear from cursor to end of line
ESC[2K - Clear entire line
ESC[1K - Clear from cursor to beginning of line

# Text attributes
ESC[0m - Reset all attributes
ESC[1m - Bold
ESC[2m - Dim
ESC[3m - Italic
ESC[4m - Underline
ESC[5m - Blink
ESC[7m - Reverse
ESC[8m - Hidden

# Colors (4-bit)
ESC[30m - Black foreground
ESC[31m - Red foreground
ESC[32m - Green foreground
ESC[33m - Yellow foreground
ESC[34m - Blue foreground
ESC[35m - Magenta foreground
ESC[36m - Cyan foreground
ESC[37m - White foreground

# Background colors
ESC[40m - Black background
ESC[41m - Red background
ESC[42m - Green background
ESC[43m - Yellow background
ESC[44m - Blue background
ESC[45m - Magenta background
ESC[46m - Cyan background
ESC[47m - White background

# Bright colors
ESC[90m - Bright black foreground
ESC[91m - Bright red foreground
ESC[92m - Bright green foreground
ESC[93m - Bright yellow foreground
ESC[94m - Bright blue foreground
ESC[95m - Bright magenta foreground
ESC[96m - Bright cyan foreground
ESC[97m - Bright white foreground

# Save/Restore cursor
ESC7 - Save cursor position
ESC8 - Restore cursor position
ESC[s - Save cursor position (ANSI)
ESC[u - Restore cursor position (ANSI)

# Scrolling
ESC[1;24r - Set scrolling region lines 1-24
ESC[r - Reset scrolling region
ESCD - Scroll down (Index)
ESCM - Scroll up (Reverse Index)
